summary: Welcome-email iteration passed the approved non-browser test scope. Source review confirmed Gmail configuration is read from server-side environment keys `GMAIL_USER`, `GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD`, and `GMAIL_FROM`; welcome delivery is triggered from Auth.js `createUser` only after a persisted new user exists; existing-user sign-in does not call the welcome delivery path; delivery attempts are claimed with `welcomeEmailAttemptedAt` to avoid duplicates; sender failures, invalid recipients, and missing configuration resolve to deterministic statuses and are logged without secret values. Evidence: `prisma/schema.prisma` has nullable welcome-email status fields; migration `20260914183000_welcome_email_status` adds them without required backfill; `src/features/registration/welcome-email.ts` contains the injectable Gmail SMTP sender; `src/features/registration/welcome-delivery.ts` contains duplicate-skip and safe failure handling; `src/auth.ts` calls delivery from `events.createUser`; `.env.local` contains the required Gmail key names with values not exposed. Commands passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`; `npx.cmd prisma validate`; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs` with 9/9 passing; `npm.cmd run lint`; `npm.cmd run build`. Browser verification, Playwright, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real Gmail delivery were not run per task constraints and are not claimed as passed.
